vectorize_state_dict: convert a PyTorch state dict into a single flattened column tensor in a repeatable sorted way
unvectorize_to_state_dict: convert a flattened vector back into a state dict matching the shapes of a reference state dict
generate_permutation_tensor: generate a tensor with numbers 0 through N-1 ordered randomly using an optional seed for reproducibility
shuffle_tensor_elements: randomly shuffle the elements of a PyTorch tensor while preserving its original shape
shuffle_state_dict_tensors: randomly shuffle each tensor in a PyTorch state dict using incrementing seeds per key
